action.content: Rewrite the following text so that it is funny to software engineers using notations from the book "The C Programming Language": "The use of the various constructions described in this chapter is one of the most distinctive features of the C programming language." Make this sound like it is being said by the president of the United States and capitalize every letter.
action.label: context

action.content: "My fellow Americans, I am pleased to declare that the utilization of the various CONSTRUCTIONS, as described in this CHAPTER, is one of the most DISTINCTIVE FEATURES of the C PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE. It is a characteristic that sets us apart from the rest of the world, much like the use of a well-placed GOTO statement or the judicious application of a macro to optimize our code. We must continue to EMULATE the great Kernighan and Ritchie, the authors of this FINE BOOK, and harness the power of the C language to build a brighter future for ourselves and for generations to come. God bless America, and God bless the C programming language!"
